research_subject: China bubble & brew 1H26 preview
executive_summary: 摩根大通指出2026上半年中国现制饮品分化：瑞幸快速扩张业绩向好，古茗、蜜雪冰城增长放缓，盈利预测分别下调5%、11%。最新评级排序为瑞幸、霸王茶姬、古茗增持，蜜雪冰城减持。建议晚些时候能见度提升后重新关注古茗。各品牌门店与营收预测详细调整。
key_findings: 瑞幸1H26净开约4.7k店，盈利或早于2Q26拐点
古茗、蜜雪FY26盈利下调5%和11%，分别低于共识2%和13%
新排序：Luckin(OW)>Chagee(OW)>Guming(OW)>Mixue(UW)

evidence.claim: 茶饮品牌踩刹车，瑞幸踩油门
evidence.quote: Markets proved perceptive again. Earlier this summer, even as the industry's same-store sales (SSS) only just edged into negative territory, valuations were already sliding sharply (Mixue/Guming down 23%/25% in 2QTD, versus the HSI down 1%).
New pecking order: Luckin (OW)> Chagee (OW) > Guming (OW)> Mixue (UW).
